scope: Retrospective walk-forward test on an already-examined archive; not a fresh holdout. No retuning on this run.
candidate_set: All 59 probability models in the frozen joint-mixture forecast artifact; no exclusions based on results.
forecasts: Reproduce every stored forecast with the original settings, then evaluate the last 1000. Each forecast uses only earlier outcomes; mixture updates begin after the original 200-draw warmup.
one_ticket: Existing top-six selection via metrics.top_k and argmax strong; retain the existing tie rule.
ten_tickets: Relabel the selected fixed coverage design independently per forecast: higher forecast scores go to more-used template labels; ties use descending occurrence count then numeric template label. Preserve all fair-draw coverage probabilities.
primary_metric: Draws with at least three main matches on at least one ticket.
null_tests: Exact upper binomial tails at the appropriate one-ticket or ten-ticket fair probability; Holm correction across all 59 x 2 budget comparisons.
temporal_check: Report four nonoverlapping 250-draw blocks. Choose the ten-ticket model with most wins in the first 500 (ties use original model order); keep that model choice fixed for the remaining 500, with its usual past-only updates.
limits: Nominal corrections describe this fixed comparison, not all previous research decisions. Frequent wins alone do not establish prediction: compare with the matched fair-draw baseline. No archive refresh or ticket purchases.
